newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares seen cautious, trade data awaited.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares seen cautious, trade data awaited.

text.p: The outlook for Singapore shares was cautious on Friday ahead of the expected announcement of official May non-oil export figures, dealers said.
"People will sit tight until the numbers are out," one dealer at a local brokerage said.
A Reuter poll on Thursday saw a 3.5 percent year-on-year rise for May's non-oil domestic exports, which would make it the second consecutive rise after five months of falls.
Thursday's Straits Times Industrials Index rise of 17.83 points to 2,002.97 was seen as an anomaly in an otherwise downward trend, dealers said.
"The market has been bashed down and I'm expecting it to stay down," one broker said.
